description: We are DeltaEcho, a team of CSE Students building a data-driven web app. So we are looking for creative minds !!!
summary:
Echoes of Earth is an interactive, browser-based climate data sonification platform that transforms 42 years (1985–2026) of silent NASA satellite observations into layered music and automated spoken narration. Traditional environmental dashboards rely entirely on color-coded maps and complex visual charts, locking out over 285 million blind and visually impaired people worldwide from experiencing and analyzing planetary change.

Addressing the Earth Information Jukebox challenge, our platform bridges this accessibility gap through two integrated engines: a 3D Solar-to-Surface Observatory and a real-time Earth Information Center (EIC) Pixel Sonification Lab. As users explore climate-vulnerable regions in Bangladesh (Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, Kutubdia, Saint Martin, Dhaka, Sundarbans) and global hotspots (Mount Everest glaciers and Pacific Northwest wildfires), our client-side engine reads raw 256x256 NASA satellite frames and maps 10 environmental telemetry layers—including sea-level surge (+137.6 mm), rainfall jumps (+752 mm), carbon rise (+68.8 ppm), and aquifer depletion into harmonic chords, rhythmic pulses, and WCAG 2.1 AAA screen-reader voice guides.
details:
1. WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

Echoes of Earth (DeltaEcho Jukebox) turns NASA satellite imagery and climate telemetry into an interactive auditory and visual experience:

- 3D Solar to Surface Observatory: Guides users across an 8-stage orbital flight from the Solar System into climate-critical zones in Bangladesh (Cox's Bazar, Chittagong, Kutubdia & St. Martin, Dhaka Urban Heat Island, Sundarbans, Sylhet) and global landmarks (Mount Everest & Khumbu Glaciers, Pacific NW Wildfires).

- 10 Toggleable Sound Layers & 5-Year A/B Delta Mode: Maps Temperature, Rainfall, Vegetation (NDVI), Forest Canopy, Groundwater (GRACE), Sea Level, Air Quality, Carbon (CO2), Night Lights, and Disasters into distinct musical instruments and frequencies across a 42-year span (1985–2026). Users can isolate individual layers or compare 5-year and 40-year environmental deltas (such as Chittagong's +137.6 mm sea-level rise and Kutubdia's +752 mm rainfall surge).

- Real-Time EIC Pixel Sonification Lab: Instead of playing pre-recorded audio files, our browser engine scans raw 256x256 NASA GIBS and Earth Information Center (EIC) satellite frames in real time (measuring 130 frames in ~527 ms). It extracts pixel-level Cloud Fraction, Mean Luminance, Greenness, Edge Energy, and Water Coverage, translating visual textures directly into pentatonic chords, filter cutoffs, and rhythmic pulses via Tone.js and the Web Audio API.

- Automated Voice Guide & Zero-Mouse Keyboard UX: A built-in speech narration engine announces exact regional climate deltas and frame statistics, paired with full keyboard shortcuts (Space to play/pause, Arrow keys to step frames, C to compare deltas, / to search).

2. INTENDED IMPACT & BENEFITS

- Inclusive Climate Literacy: Empowers 285M+ blind and low-vision citizens, students, and researchers to independently explore NASA Earth science data without visual barriers.

- Local & Global Climate Awareness: Highlights frontline climate realities for 40+ million coastal residents in Bangladesh alongside global cryosphere and wildfire shifts.

- Multi-Sensory Pattern Recognition: The human ear excels at detecting subtle shifts in pitch, tempo, and dissonance, allowing both sighted and blind researchers to hear anomalies across 10 simultaneous variables that are difficult to spot on static charts.

3. TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

- Frontend & 3D Rendering: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), WebGL2 / Three.js for interactive 3D globe rendering, and HTML5 Canvas API for real-time 256x256 pixel matrix extraction.

- Audio Synthesis & Accessibility: Web Audio API, Tone.js (real-time polyphonic synthesis, harmonic mapping, and spatial panning), Web Speech API / ARIA Live Regions, and WCAG 2.1 AAA compliance.

- Deployment & Version Control: Git, GitHub, and GitHub Pages.

4. CREATIVITY, ACCESSIBILITY, ENERGY & COST CONSIDERATIONS

- Zero Server Cost & Low Energy Footprint: 100% client-side architecture. By synthesizing audio mathematically in the user's browser rather than streaming heavy pre-rendered audio files or running GPU backend servers, the app requires zero hosting cost, minimal bandwidth, and low energy consumption.

- Accessibility from Day One: Designed with high-contrast editorial UI, full screen-reader compatibility, and zero-mouse keyboard navigation so anyone can operate the entire observatory by sound and touch.
